title: NO KEY || free walkspeed changer and shift lock
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- SETTINGS
local speed = 16
local MIN_SPEED = 1
local MAX_SPEED = 10000
local STEP = 1

local speedEnabled = false
local shiftLockEnabled = false

local HOLD_DELAY = 1
local HOLD_INTERVAL = 0.05
local HOLD_STEP = 5

local plusHeld = false
local minusHeld = false

-- GUI
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "MovementUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- OPEN BUTTON
local openButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
openButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(55, 55)
openButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0.5, -27)
openButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30)
openButton.Text = "⚙"
openButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
openButton.TextSize = 27
openButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
openButton.Parent = gui

local openCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
openCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
openCorner.Parent = openButton

local openStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
openStroke.Thickness = 2
openStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(75, 75, 85)
openStroke.Parent = openButton

-- MAIN MENU
local main = Instance.new("Frame")
main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(250, 205)
main.Position = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0.5, -102)
main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 27)
main.Visible = false
main.Parent = gui

local mainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
mainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 18)
mainCorner.Parent = main

local mainStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
mainStroke.Thickness = 1.5
mainStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(65, 65, 75)
mainStroke.Parent = main

-- TITLE
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 28)
title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 8)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "MOVEMENT"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 240)
title.TextSize = 15
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.Parent = main

-- SPEED DISPLAY
local speedLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
speedLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 35)
speedLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 35)
speedLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
speedLabel.Text = "16"
speedLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
speedLabel.TextSize = 26
speedLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
speedLabel.Parent = main

-- MINUS
local minus = Instance.new("TextButton")
minus.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(55, 48)
minus.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 83)
minus.Text = "−"
minus.TextSize = 25
minus.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
minus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
minus.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 50)
minus.Parent = main

-- SPEED TOGGLE
local speedToggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
speedToggle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(110, 48)
speedToggle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 83)
speedToggle.Text = "SPEED: OFF"
speedToggle.TextSize = 14
speedToggle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
speedToggle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
speedToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 50)
speedToggle.Parent = main

-- PLUS
local plus = Instance.new("TextButton")
plus.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(55, 48)
plus.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(185, 83)
plus.Text = "+"
plus.TextSize = 25
plus.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
plus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
plus.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 50)
plus.Parent = main

-- SHIFT LOCK
local shiftLock = Instance.new("TextButton")
shiftLock.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(230, 48)
shiftLock.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 145)
shiftLock.Text = "SHIFT LOCK: OFF"
shiftLock.TextSize = 15
shiftLock.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
shiftLock.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
shiftLock.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 50)
shiftLock.Parent = main

for _, button in ipairs({
	minus,
	speedToggle,
	plus,
	shiftLock
}) do
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
	corner.Parent = button
end

-- OPEN/CLOSE
openButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	main.Visible = not main.Visible
end)

-- CHARACTER
local function getCharacter()
	local character = player.Character

	if not character then
		return nil, nil, nil
	end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	return character, humanoid, root
end

-- UI
local function updateUI()
	speedLabel.Text = tostring(speed)

	if speedEnabled then
		speedToggle.Text = "SPEED: ON"
		speedToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 170, 85)
	else
		speedToggle.Text = "SPEED: OFF"
		speedToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 50)
	end

	if shiftLockEnabled then
		shiftLock.Text = "SHIFT LOCK: ON"
		shiftLock.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 170, 85)
	else
		shiftLock.Text = "SHIFT LOCK: OFF"
		shiftLock.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 50)
	end
end

-- CHANGE SPEED
local function changeSpeed(amount)
	speed = math.clamp(
		speed + amount,
		MIN_SPEED,
		MAX_SPEED
	)

	updateUI()
end

-- TAP + / -
plus.Activated:Connect(function()
	changeSpeed(STEP)
end)

minus.Activated:Connect(function()
	changeSpeed(-STEP)
end)

-- HOLD +
plus.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

		plusHeld = true

		task.spawn(function()
			local heldTime = 0

			while plusHeld do
				task.wait(HOLD_INTERVAL)

				if not plusHeld then
					break
				end

				heldTime += HOLD_INTERVAL

				if heldTime >= HOLD_DELAY then
					changeSpeed(HOLD_STEP)
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end)

plus.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

		plusHeld = false
	end
end)

-- HOLD -
minus.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

		minusHeld = true

		task.spawn(function()
			local heldTime = 0

			while minusHeld do
				task.wait(HOLD_INTERVAL)

				if not minusHeld then
					break
				end

				heldTime += HOLD_INTERVAL

				if heldTime >= HOLD_DELAY then
					changeSpeed(-HOLD_STEP)
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end)

minus.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

		minusHeld = false
	end
end)

-- TOGGLES
speedToggle.Activated:Connect(function()
	speedEnabled = not speedEnabled
	updateUI()
end)

shiftLock.Activated:Connect(function()
	shiftLockEnabled = not shiftLockEnabled
	updateUI()
end)

-- MOVEMENT
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	local character, humanoid, root = getCharacter()

	if not humanoid or not root then
		return
	end

	-- SPEED
	if speedEnabled then
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = speed
	else
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
	end

	-- SHIFT LOCK
	if shiftLockEnabled then
		humanoid.AutoRotate = false

		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

		if camera then
			local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
			local flatLook = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)

			if flatLook.Magnitude > 0 then
				root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
					root.Position,
					root.Position + flatLook.Unit
				)
			end
		end
	else
		humanoid.AutoRotate = true
	end

	-- RAMP-STABLE MOVEMENT
	if speedEnabled then
		local direction = humanoid.MoveDirection

		if direction.Magnitude > 0 then

			local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
			rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}

			local rayOrigin = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
			local rayDirection = Vector3.new(0, -7, 0)

			local result = workspace:Raycast(
				rayOrigin,
				rayDirection,
				rayParams
			)

			local moveVelocity

			if result then
				-- Follow the surface of the ramp
				local normal = result.Normal

				local projected =
					direction.Unit
					- normal * direction.Unit:Dot(normal)

				if projected.Magnitude > 0 then
					projected = projected.Unit * speed
				else
					projected = direction.Unit * speed
				end

				moveVelocity = projected
			else
				moveVelocity = direction.Unit * speed
			end

			-- Limit vertical physics so ramps don't launch you
			local verticalVelocity =
				math.clamp(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, -50, 35)

			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
				moveVelocity.X,
				verticalVelocity,
				moveVelocity.Z
			)

		else

			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
				0,
				math.clamp(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, -50, 35),
				0
			)

		end

		-- Stop unwanted spinning
		root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end
end)

-- RESPAWN
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)

	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	task.wait(0.1)

	if speedEnabled then
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = speed
	else
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
	end

	humanoid.AutoRotate = not shiftLockEnabled

	updateUI()
end)

updateUI()
features: It has really good walk changer and plus this is the best one becuz you wont slip, fling, or slide
